observer_API: UsageObserver(config, *, checkpoint=None).export_checkpoint() -> bounded JSON object. Existing constructor calls remain valid, but gate supplies previous checkpoint after first invocation.
identity: Bind current sealed directory dev/inode/path plus expected cwd/provider/model/budget/prior session identities into config_sha256. File identity contains exact native UUID.jsonl name/device/inode. Prefix stores byte length and SHA256, not raw transcript. Counts store four known completed counters. Sticky STOP survives restore.
gate_history: Root-private immutable existing gate-outcome records become schema v2 and carry sequence, previous_outcome_sha256 and usage_checkpoint. Read whole <=40record/1MiB history with nofollow before evaluation; require exact contiguous chain and same gate config. Reinstantiate observer from latest checkpoint. Serialize concurrent gate evaluations with one private identity-checked O_EXCL lock; stale lock fails closed, never silently removed.
guarded_transition: Read current session and require samefileidentity, nonshorter SHA256-matching prior prefix, monotonic counts. Missing/replaced/truncated/mutated/partial/incomplete usage produces durable STOP_USAGE_UNKNOWN. Replaying a lower transcript cannot become WAITING or WITHIN_BUDGET after completedusage.
TCB: History/outcome/config directory is root-private and not available to modeltools. Whole trustedhistory deletion/substitution by a malicious same-UID host remains outside A2TCB, like wholesale run-state substitution. Hashchain is not a secret/signature or external hostilehostwitness. No new scientificrun/statusauthority.
publication_failure: Any corrupt/incompletechain/lock/failure prevents validREADY and returns STOP_PROTOCOL_INVALID. Nativeexit0 stopscontinuations; parentreadsindependentdurableoutcome andneverpromotesmissingreceipt.
